name: codex-gardener
description: Silently queue Codex task lessons, curate them at the right scope, retrieve promoted guidance locally, and audit effectiveness without telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Silently queue, retrieve, and curate reusable knowledge locally.
interface.longDescription: Silently queue bounded lessons from real Codex tasks without adding chat continuations, retrieve relevant promoted repository and global guidance from a local derived SQLite index, review candidates in scheduled maintenance, and audit privacy-bounded effectiveness locally.
defaultPrompt: Review this completed task and capture reusable knowledge at the right scope.
Curate repository and global learning candidates.
Coordinate repository writes with project ownership and isolated Git worktrees.
